question: Which of the following options can be the value of k if ((143div 13 × k-3times 3))/(( 6²⁾⁻⁷times ⁵⁺k^{²) } = 1
solution:
**Given **

 ((143div 13 × k-3times 3))/(( 6²⁾⁻⁷times ⁵⁺k^{²) } = 1

**Solution:**

 ((143div 13 × k-3times 3))/(( 6²⁾⁻⁷times ⁵⁺k^{²) }=1

11× k-9= 36-35+k²

10+k²-11k=0

⇒ Upon solving, the equation translates into k² - 11k + 10 = 0

⇒ The roots of this equation are k = 1

**Therefore, the value of k is 1.**
